about:
Felbro Food Products, Inc. is a family-owned food manufacturer headquartered in Los Angeles, California. The company was founded in 1946 and has operated continuously as a private enterprise, building a reputation for high-touch service and rapid response times.

The company provides full-service food manufacturing solutions, including research and development, product formulation, and production for the food and beverage sector. Its capabilities span custom recipe development, pilot-scale testing, and commercial-scale manufacturing, serving clients from concept through to finished goods.

Felbro serves a range of food-industry customers, including quick-service restaurant chains, foodservice distributors, and branded consumer-product companies. The firm notes that it has worked with some of the world’s most recognized names in the food business, though specific client names are not disclosed.

The company emphasizes its family-owned structure as a differentiator, citing a culture of personal service, fast turnaround, and consistent quality as the reasons it has remained a preferred partner for over seven decades.
